newsitem.title: CHINA: CKI awards HK$3.8 bln mandate.
newsitem.headline: CKI awards HK$3.8 bln mandate.

text.p: BA Asia, Sumitomo Bank and Banque Paribas have been mandated to arrange a HK$3.8 billion term loan/revolving credit for Cheung Kong Infrastructure Ltd (CKI), bankers said on Wednesday.
Syndication should start on Friday, and top-level participants will probably receive an all-in of about 50 basis points or slightly less, bankers said.
This is significantly lower than the 97 basis point all-in paid by New World Infrastructure Ltd in its recent five-year term loan/revolving credit.
But bankers said they liked the CKI's 35 percent stake in The Hong Kong Electric Co Ltd, its ownership of two cement plants and its connection with Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd .
New World Infrastructure is rated BBB-minus for long-term foreign currency by Standard & Poor's, which recently assigned an A-minus long-term corporate credit rating to CKI.
